title: Current generator tables for quake2 (byte-equivalent to the pre-X2 code)

q2src.description: id Software GPL source release of Quake II (Quake-2-master): game/ (baseq2 game DLL), ctf/ (ThreeWave CTF 1.09b game DLL), qcommon/ (pmove), server/.

origin: Copied verbatim from src/map_builder.cpp (solid_material, liquid_material, variant_class, classname_for) and src/entities.cpp (add_lighting, weapon_variant_count, monster_variant_count) before change x2-profiles. They mirror current behaviour and are not id-source facts; known_defects lists where they disagree with the module profiles.

liquid.note: A solid brush cannot take the liquid role (map build error invalid_material_role).

solid.note: Solid contents take a solid material (map build error invalid_liquid_contract).

player_start.note: Change r1s-mp-player-start (switch r1s.mp_player_start): also emitted exactly once in every Quake 2 multiplayer map (deathmatch, duel, CTF), for `map` loads with deathmatch 0, whose spawn-point search aborts without it (cited). Deathmatch spawn selection never reads it; the proof is in src/entities.cpp and the change record. The value was already info_player_start.

intermission.note: Added by change r1s-q1-intermission to keep the PlacementRole partition complete. Mapping only: no Quake 2 intermission placement is generated yet, and the map builder refuses one (Quake 2 and Quake 3 intermission points are a later R1-s cause).

coop_start.note: Added by change r1s-sp-coop-starts (switch r1s.sp_coop_starts, D8 role coop_start): three are emitted beside the info_player_start of every Quake 2 single-player map, with no targetname, because a generated map is loaded directly (empty spawnpoint). SelectCoopSpawnPoint gives co-op client N >= 1 the Nth matching info_player_coop and the start otherwise (cited), and PutClientInServer KillBox-es the spot, so without them co-op clients telefrag on the start. SP_info_player_coop frees the entity when coop is 0.

weapon.note: Order is significant: a placement's variant index selects from this list.

monster.note: Order is significant: a placement's variant index selects from this list.

monster_soldier.note: Change r1s-monster-hull-support (switch r1s.monster_hull_support): the spawn box each monster class sets. walkmonster_start_go drops the monster with M_droptofloor, which leaves it in place when its box starts in solid (trace.allsolid), then reports "in solid" when M_walkmove(self, 0, 0) fails (game/g_monster.c:310-321, 671-680); M_CheckBottom refuses a step when a bottom corner hangs more than STEPSIZE (18) over an edge (game/m_move.c:37-97).

item_armor_combat.note: Change r1s-sp-pickup-hull-support (switch r1s.sp_pickup_hull_support): the box droptofloor sets for every item before it traces the item 128 units down with MASK_SOLID; when the trace starts in solid the item is freed ("droptofloor: %s startsolid") (game/g_items.c:918-946). A box that only touches a brush face starts in solid: CM_ClipBoxToBrush counts the start outside a brush only when it is strictly in front of a face (qcommon/cmodel.c:1048-1049, 1077-1079). With no floor within 128 units the item is left at the trace end.

analysis_spawn_eye_offset_z.note: Height added to player-spawn origins for the visibility analysis; still a literal in src/visibility.cpp (not read from this file).

spawn_refinement_eye_offset_z.note: Literal +22 eye used by the spawn refinement passes; not read from this file.

known_defects.detail: The weapon variants leave out weapon_supershotgun and weapon_bfg.
Team spawns and flags exist only in the CTF game DLL, not in baseq2.
e1u1/ceil1_4 carries SURF_LIGHT 10000 in its WAL, so every ceiling emits light (Phase-1 audit). Not re-checked here.
These liquid textures are not in baseq2 (Phase-1 audit). Not re-checked here.
cite: repo:docs/RC_PHASE1_AUDIT_AND_PLAN.md:836|- e1u1/water1, slime1 and lava1 are not in baseq2.
